# What’s new in Microsoft Intune at Ignite
## Govern agent access and set execution boundaries
Organizations can extend the same consistent protection they use for work data to these apps, helping them meet governance requirements as AI adoption grows.

...

## Reduce exposure across the estate
At Ignite, we are advancing [Microsoft Perception](https://aka.ms/perceptionignite) with a set of green team agents including the Risk Reduction, Vulnerability Remediation, and Shielding agents to help security and IT teams assess exposure, prioritize risks, and coordinate mitigation and remediation.
The Intune **Vulnerability Remediation Agent** , in limited public preview, combines Defender vulnerability intelligence with Intune device and app context to build and execute agentic remediation playbooks for prioritized risks. These playbooks enable automated application and OS patching, connecting risk discovery to automated remediation on Intune managed devices.
The Vulnerability Remediation Agent is available within Perception as part of the Reduce Risk Exposure playbook and in the Intune admin center for IT to run at any time.

...

## Next steps for IT admins
AI is expanding both what IT can enable and what IT must protect. With these announcements, Intune is helping IT govern agents and the environments where they run, reduce exposure through ongoing maintenance and targeted remediation, and extend familiar management to more of the estate. New AI-powered experiences help administrators turn complex signals into clearer next steps, while improvements to everyday workflows support IT and employees alike.

results.title: Edge for Business becomes the most used enterprise browser and unveils Ignite 2026 innovations - Microsoft Edge Blog
excerpts:
# Edge for Business becomes the most used enterprise browser and unveils Ignite 2026 innovations
## Jump to
* Agents that work your way, on your terms : Reusable skills, faster skills, fewer tokens, agents in managed browsing, and more on governance and a system of safety.
* Everyday browsing, made smarter : Update web experiences without code, create an interactive brief from tabs, write and plan with context from your work.

...

## Agents that work your way, on your terms
Your organization is probably already juggling more than one agent. Alongside Microsoft Copilot, your users may rely on agents such as Claude or ChatGPT, in dedicated apps, command-line tools, or custom builds. Users want the power. You need the control.
Whatever the agent, Microsoft or otherwise, it should do its best work in Edge for Business: faster, with fewer tokens, and more accurate results. IT and security teams get predictability too: agents can run in the managed browser you’ve configured, under your control and visibility. Today we’re sharing the first building blocks.

### Delegate everyday browsing tasks to Cowork
_At a glance: Cowork in Edge for Business now includes agentic browsing: it can complete multi-step tasks across websites on users’ behalf._
At Ignite last year, we introduced AI browsing with Copilot in Edge for Business, and many of you put it to work in preview. Thank you. We’re excited to share agentic browsing is now part of Cowork, available via the sidepane, the new tab page, and web. With this, users have one place to delegate work, from creating docs to prepping for meetings or completing a task on the web.
It’s an easy way for users to get comfortable with agentic work, starting with small, everyday tasks, so they can get back to the work that takes creativity, judgment, and complex thinking.
[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-oSn_uaNILs "Play Video")
_Generally available. Requires Microsoft 365 Copilot license with usage-based billing enabled._

### Turn complex tasks into Cowork skills by simply recording them
_At a glance: Skills recorder in Edge for Business turns a workflow into a reusable, sharable Cowork skill._
Cowork handles everyday tasks well. But some work is more complex: it can take many steps, span multiple systems, and depend on specialized knowledge. With skills recorder, a user can record themselves completing an end-to-end process once and turn it into a skill that can be shared with teammates. And because the skill follows the same proven steps every time, that means fewer tokens spent and more consistent results.
[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pEnuYGyqdUY "Play Video")
_Available in preview by end of year. Requires Microsoft 365 Copilot license with usage-based billing enabled._

### Faster skills that use fewer tokens
_At a glance: Edge for Business is working to help any agent complete common web tasks faster and with fewer tokens._
We’re working on optimizing how agents carry out the most common actions on the world’s most popular websites. Regardless of the agent being used, Edge for Business will take the most token-efficient path to task completion. Early internal tests show an average of 30% less token usage. It’s early, but the direction is clear: faster results, fewer tokens per task, and more consistent execution.

...

### Put browser agents on managed ground
_At a glance: The managed agent browsing experience in Edge for Business helps IT bring Microsoft and other providers into a governed browser, under the policies IT already manages._
Every agent that opens a browser raises the same practical questions: Can the agent access more than the person it represents? Do data protections still apply? Can users and admins tell whether a person or an agent is working?
The new managed agent browsing experience enables IT to help enforce the use of Edge for Business by agents from Microsoft and other providers. This helps ensure that whenever an agentic task needs a browser, it occurs within the bounds of a governed browser. Each agent works in a dedicated window with its own Microsoft Entra agent identity, and operates within the user’s existing permissions and organizational policies.
Visual cues make it clear when a window belongs to an agent.
_Available in preview with Microsoft 365 E5 license._

### What’s next: see and govern browser agents alongside other agents
_At a glance: Our vision is to bring browser agents into Agent 365 and Microsoft Entra logs, so you can govern them alongside other agents and tell their actions apart from a person’s._
Our vision is to make agents running in Edge for Business visible and governable across Microsoft’s identity and management tools. Because each agent session carries its own Entra agent identity, you’ll be able to view browser agents in Agent 365 alongside the rest of your organization’s agents.
In the future, see which agents are in use and who’s using them, apply policies, and block or quarantine an agent that isn’t approved or is exhibiting risky behavior. When you need to investigate, Microsoft Entra logs will show which agent took an action and which user it was acting for, so agent actions are easy to tell apart from those of a person.
[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0_R0vy13KTY "Play Video")

### An integrated system of safety for built-in AI
_At a glance: AI built into Edge for Business is backed by existing enterprise protections, policy-based rollout, and safeguards for agentic browsing._

...

* **Purpose-built agentic safeguards:** Cowork browses within the user’s existing permissions and organizational policies. Users stay in control: Cowork hands back sign-ins and payments, asks before sensitive actions, and can be watched or stopped at any time.

...

## Everyday browsing, made smarter
### Turn information across tabs into an interactive brief
An executive asks for a status update. You have the data, but it’s scattered and you don’t know what they want to dig into. Instead of building a presentation to anticipate every question, interactive brief quickly turns the information across your browser tabs into an interactive page that can be explored during the meeting and shared afterward.

...

### Get writing help, informed by your work
_At a glance: Writing assistance in Edge for Business helps users write in any form field with context from their work._
Writing assistance in Edge for Business helps users draft and edit text in form fields, including on internal and line-of-business sites that rarely have writing help built in. Connected to Work IQ, it can write using context from the user’s calendar, files, and more.
[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nxx8UrxDpCQ "Play Video")
_Available in preview. Work grounding requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license._

...

### Get suggested next steps with Journeys
Piecing together status and action items across calendars, emails, and chats takes time. Journeys—shown as “Get things done” on a new tab page—performs that legwork and suggests next steps on workstreams, based on the user’s work and browsing context.
_Available in preview. Requires Microsoft 365 Copilot license._

## Browser security in a high-velocity threat environment
The best enterprise browser for humans and agents needs more than agent guardrails: a rock-solid security foundation for today’s enterprise browsing must be in place. With cyberthreats moving at a historic pace, you need practical security solutions now.

...

## Browser security, strengthened by our partner ecosystem
### Manage browser policies across customer tenants with inforcer
This not only saves time but also gives MSPs a foundation for managed browser security offerings. The baseline supports Windows and macOS, and each customer tenant requires a Microsoft Intune license.

...

excerpts:
# SharePoint and OneDrive at Microsoft Ignite 2026: Putting AI-powered content to work
## SharePoint: The knowledge platform for Copilot and agents
* **SharePoint tools in Work IQ and the Copilot app are now in public preview.** Copilot and agents now have access to more than 60 SharePoint operations spanning lists and libraries, files and folders, search, approvals, rules, Quick Steps, versioning, and more. In our internal evaluations, adding SharePoint tools increased Work IQ’s task pass rate from 70.1% to 84.6%, while using 16% fewer tokens.
[Read more](https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/blog/spblog/introducing-sharepoint-tools-in-work-iq/4569917) .
* **New Work IQ context enhancements are rolling out to public preview starting this month.** These enhancements bring the deep document grounding that powers Copilot experiences to custom agents through Work IQ, with agent-friendly document markdown, images and thumbnails, summaries, and semantic lookup within files.
Over time, these capabilities will expand to deep context understanding for SharePoint sites, Teams chats, channels and meetings, and Outlook emails.
* **Knowledge base in SharePoint rolled out to Frontier preview in October.** Turn existing content and expertise into curated knowledge that is easier for both people and AI to discover, maintain, and use.

...

# See Copilot in SharePoint in action
## Govern and manage content for AI
* [**SharePoint Admin Agent**](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sharepoint/content-governance-agent) brings natural-language tenant analysis and guided remediation across permissions and oversharing management, content lifecycle, storage, catalog, and settings.

...

We’re excited to spend the week showing what this next chapter looks like, and how SharePoint and OneDrive are helping organizations put their content and knowledge to work with Copilot and agents.
Updated Nov 17, 2026
